title: Marlowe Rewards Member Notice — Restocking-Fee Waiver Tiers and Deposit Pre-Order Cancellation Charges
content:
**Benefit.** A Marlowe Rewards member whose tier carries the programme's restocking-fee waiver has a reduced charge when cancelling a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order at will:

- enrolled 60 months or more: the cancellation charge is multiplied by **0.5**;
- enrolled fewer than 60 months: it is multiplied by **0.75**.

Every other customer's charge is multiplied by **1.0**.

The multiplier applies to the cancellation charge as one more factor of the same product of the reserved price and the charge rate. It applies before the cap at the deposit held and before the rounding to the cent, both of which apply to the whole product.

**Records read.** The customer's active Marlowe Rewards membership: whether its tier carries the restocking-fee waiver, and its enrolment date. Months are counted from the enrolment date to today.

**Combinations (hypothetical members)**

| Tier carries the restocking-fee waiver | Months since enrolment | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 60 | 0.5 |
| Yes | 59 | 0.75 |
| Yes | 4 | 0.75 |
| No | 120 | 1.0 |
| No active membership | — | 1.0 |

**Example (hypothetical).** A cancellation charge of $64.00 for a member of 7 years' standing, whose tier carries the waiver, becomes $32.00.
